memberdef.initializer: int \ xrow_update_op_do_map_##op_type(struct xrow_update_op *op, \ struct xrow_update_field *field) \ { \ assert(field->type == XUPDATE_MAP); \ struct xrow_update_map_item *item = \ xrow_update_map_extract_item(field, op); \ if (item == NULL) \ return -1; \ if (!xrow_update_op_is_term(op)) { \ op->is_token_consumed = true; \ return xrow_update_op_do_field_##op_type(op, &item->field); \ } \ if (item->field.type != XUPDATE_NOP) \ return xrow_update_err_double(op); \ if (xrow_update_op_do_##op_type(op, item->field.data) != 0) \ return -1; \ item->field.type = XUPDATE_SCALAR; \ item->field.scalar.op = op; \ return 0; \ }
